_note: direct: institutional and research feeds. Those carried over from sibling
repos are already proven working; the rest follow each body's documented
feed path. Any that does not answer is reported as unreachable in the status
line and in Sources & coverage rather than being hidden.
gnews: Google News locale searches. The harvester builds the URL from
hl / gl / ceid. Twenty-four queries rotate across 46 locales so the whole
subject range is covered rather than one theme repeated.
events: subject searches for recurring publications and enforcement actions.
official  regulators, central banks, courts, the IMF, World Bank, OECD, BIS
press     general news across the locales
